sanskrit: sa̱mi̱dhyamā̍naḥ pratha̱mānu̱ dharmā̱ sam a̱ktubhi̍r ajyate vi̱śvavā̍raḥ | śo̱ciṣke̍śo ghṛ̱tani̍rṇik pāva̱kaḥ su̍ya̱jño a̱gnir ya̱jathā̍ya de̱vān ||
english: Being kindled first according to holy law, he is anointed with streams of oil — the all-desirable one; flame-haired, robed in ghee, the purifier, Agni the good sacrificer, is ready to worship the gods.

sanskrit: yathāya̍jo ho̱tram a̍gne pṛthi̱vyā yathā̍ di̱vo jā̍tavedaś ciki̱tvān | e̱vānena̍ ha̱viṣā̍ yakṣi de̱vān ma̍nu̱ṣvad ya̱jñam pra ti̍re̱mam a̱dya ||
english: As you, O Agni, Jātavedas, wise and knowing, performed the priestly office on earth and in heaven — so with this oblation worship the gods today; extend this sacrifice in the manner of Manu.

sanskrit: trīṇy āyū̍ṁṣi̱ tava̍ jātavedas ti̱sra ā̱jānī̍r u̱ṣasa̍s te agne | tābhi̍r de̱vānā̱m avo̍ yakṣi vi̱dvān athā̍ bhava̱ yaja̍mānāya̱ śaṁ yoḥ ||
english: Three are your lifetimes, O Jātavedas; three are your birth-forms at the dawns, O Agni. With those, wise one, worship and secure the favor of the gods; then be a source of welfare and healing for the worshipper.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ su̍dī̱tiṁ su̱dṛśa̍ṁ gṛ̱ṇanto̍ nama̱syāma̱s tveḍya̍ṁ jātavedaḥ | tvāṁ dū̱tam a̍ra̱tiṁ ha̍vya̱vāha̍ṁ de̱vā a̍kṛṇvann a̱mṛta̍sya̱ nābhi̍m ||
english: Praising Agni of bright luster and fair aspect, we bow before you, O Jātavedas, worthy of hymns. The gods made you their messenger, the eager one, the carrier of oblations, the navel-center of immortality.

sanskrit: yas tvad dhotā̱ pūrvo̍ agne̱ yajī̍yān dvi̱tā ca̱ sattā̍ sva̱dhayā̍ ca śa̱mbhuḥ | tasyānu̱ dharma̱ pra ya̍jā ciki̱tvo 'thā̍ no dhā adhva̱raṁ de̱vavī̍tau ||
english: He who was your predecessor as Hotṛ priest, O Agni, more skilled at sacrifice, seated doubly, beneficent by his own nature — following his ordinance, O wise one, perform the sacrifice; then set our ceremony in the sight of the gods.

sanskrit: bhavā̍ no agne su̱manā̱ upe̍tau̱ sakhe̍va̱ sakhye̍ pi̱tare̍va sā̱dhuḥ | pu̱ru̱druho̱ hi kṣi̱tayo̱ janā̍nā̱m prati̍ pratī̱cīr da̍hatā̱d arā̍tīḥ ||
english: Be well-disposed toward us, O Agni, as you draw near — good as a friend to a friend, as a father. For the dwelling-places of men abound with malice; burn down those enmities that turn to face us.

sanskrit: tapo̱ ṣv a̍gne̱ anta̍rām̐ a̱mitrā̱n tapā̱ śaṁsa̱m ara̍ruṣa̱ḥ para̍sya | tapo̍ vaso cikitā̱no a̱cittā̱n vi te̍ tiṣṭhantām a̱jarā̍ a̱yāsa̍ḥ ||
english: Scorch our enemies with your heat, O Agni; scorch the malicious curse of the hostile one; O Vasu, wise and knowing, scorch the foolish ones — may your ageless, untiring flames spread forth against them.

sanskrit: i̱dhmenā̍gna i̱cchamā̍no ghṛ̱tena̍ ju̱homi̍ ha̱vyaṁ tara̍se̱ balā̍ya | yāva̱d īśe̱ brahma̍ṇā̱ vanda̍māna i̱māṁ dhiya̍ṁ śata̱seyā̍ya de̱vīm ||
english: O Agni, desiring it with fuel and with ghee, I offer the oblation for swiftness and for strength. As far as my power reaches, honoring with prayer, I dedicate this divine vision to win the hundredfold reward.

sanskrit: uc cho̱ciṣā̍ sahasas putra stu̱to bṛ̱had vaya̍ḥ śaśamā̱neṣu̍ dhehi | re̱vad a̍gne vi̱śvāmi̍treṣu̱ śaṁ yor ma̍rmṛ̱jmā te̍ ta̱nva1̱̍m bhūri̱ kṛtva̍ḥ ||
english: Rise up with your flame, O son of strength, praised one; bestow great vitality upon those who toil. O Agni, may there be rich welfare among the Viśvāmitras; having polished your body many times over, we invoke your benevolence.

sanskrit: kṛ̱dhi ratna̍ṁ susanita̱r dhanā̍nā̱ṁ sa ghed a̍gne bhavasi̱ yat sami̍ddhaḥ | sto̱tur du̍ro̱ṇe su̱bhaga̍sya re̱vat sṛ̱prā ka̱rasnā̍ dadhiṣe̱ vapū̍ṁṣi ||
english: Bestow a jewel, O excellent winner of wealth — for you become that, O Agni, when you are kindled. In the house of the fortunate praiser you assume your splendid, clinging, crackling forms of beauty.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ hotā̍ra̱m pra vṛ̍ṇe mi̱yedhe̱ gṛtsa̍ṁ ka̱viṁ vi̍śva̱vida̱m amū̍ram | sa no̍ yakṣad de̱vatā̍tā̱ yajī̍yān rā̱ye vājā̍ya vanate ma̱ghāni̍ ||
english: I choose Agni as Hotṛ at the sacrifice — keen, wise, all-knowing, faultless. May he, most skilled at worship, sacrifice for us and win the wealth and favor of the divine host, winning bounteous gifts.

sanskrit: pra te̍ agne ha̱viṣma̍tīm iya̱rmy acchā̍ sudyu̱mnāṁ rā̱tinī̍ṁ ghṛ̱tācī̍m | pra̱da̱kṣi̱ṇid de̱vatā̍tim urā̱ṇaḥ saṁ rā̱tibhi̱r vasu̍bhir ya̱jñam a̍śret ||
english: I send forth to you, O Agni, a prayer rich in oblations, of splendid glory, giving gifts, gleaming with ghee. Moving rightward, he who embraces the divine host joins the sacrifice with its offerings of good things.

sanskrit: sa tejī̍yasā̱ mana̍sā̱ tvota̍ u̱ta śi̍kṣa svapa̱tyasya̍ śi̱kṣoḥ | agne̍ rā̱yo nṛta̍masya̱ prabhū̍tau bhū̱yāma̍ te suṣṭu̱taya̍ś ca̱ vasva̍ḥ ||
english: Protected by you, O Agni, may we with a keener mind both learn and teach from him who teaches good lordship. In the abundance of the most heroic riches, may we be your praisers and masters of wealth.

sanskrit: bhūrī̍ṇi̱ hi tve da̍dhi̱re anī̱kāgne̍ de̱vasya̱ yajya̍vo̱ janā̍saḥ | sa ā va̍ha de̱vatā̍tiṁ yaviṣṭha̱ śardho̱ yad a̱dya di̱vyaṁ yajā̍si ||
english: For many forces have been placed in you, O Agni; the peoples, sacrificing to the god, call on you. O youngest one, bring hither the divine troop — the heavenly host — which you worship today.

sanskrit: yat tvā̱ hotā̍ram a̱naja̍n mi̱yedhe̍ niṣā̱daya̍nto ya̱jathā̍ya de̱vāḥ | sa tvaṁ no̍ agne 'vi̱teha bo̱dhy adhi̱ śravā̍ṁsi dhehi nas ta̱nūṣu̍ ||
english: When the gods anointed you as Hotṛ at the sacrifice, seating you for the act of worship — be you then, O Agni, our ever-present guardian here; bestow renown upon our persons.

sanskrit: a̱gnim u̱ṣasa̍m a̱śvinā̍ dadhi̱krāṁ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu havate̱ vahni̍r u̱kthaiḥ | su̱jyoti̍ṣo naḥ śṛṇvantu de̱vāḥ sa̱joṣa̍so adhva̱raṁ vā̍vaśā̱nāḥ ||
english: The carrier of offerings invokes with hymns at the dawning, Agni, Uṣas, the two Aśvins, and Dadhikrā. May the gods of beautiful light hear us, delighting together, desiring the sacrifice.

sanskrit: agne̱ trī te̱ vāji̍nā̱ trī ṣa̱dhasthā̍ ti̱sras te̍ ji̱hvā ṛ̍tajāta pū̱rvīḥ | ti̱sra u̍ te ta̱nvo̍ de̱vavā̍tā̱s tābhi̍r naḥ pāhi̱ giro̱ apra̍yucchan ||
english: O Agni, you have three powerful steeds, three dwelling-places; three are your tongues, ancient, born of truth. Three also are your bodies beloved of the gods — with these, guard our songs, never faltering.

sanskrit: agne̱ bhūrī̍ṇi̱ tava̍ jātavedo̱ deva̍ svadhāvo̱ 'mṛta̍sya̱ nāma̍ | yāś ca̍ mā̱yā mā̱yinā̍ṁ viśvaminva̱ tve pū̱rvīḥ sa̍ṁda̱dhuḥ pṛ̍ṣṭabandho ||
english: O Agni, Jātavedas, O god of your own nature, many are your names in the realm of immortality. And the ancient magical powers of all magicians that pervade all, O ridgepole-binder, have been deposited in you.

sanskrit: a̱gnir ne̱tā bhaga̍ iva kṣitī̱nāṁ daivī̍nāṁ de̱va ṛ̍tu̱pā ṛ̱tāvā̍ | sa vṛ̍tra̱hā sa̱nayo̍ vi̱śvave̍dā̱ḥ parṣa̱d viśvāti̍ duri̱tā gṛ̱ṇanta̍m ||
english: Agni is the leader of settlements as Bhaga is, the divine god who guards the seasons, who holds to truth. He, the Vṛtra-slayer, ancient, all-knowing, shall carry the singer across all difficulties.

sanskrit: da̱dhi̱krām a̱gnim u̱ṣasa̍ṁ ca de̱vīm bṛha̱spati̍ṁ savi̱tāra̍ṁ ca de̱vam | a̱śvinā̍ mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā̱ bhaga̍ṁ ca̱ vasū̍n ru̱drām̐ ā̍di̱tyām̐ i̱ha hu̍ve ||
english: Dadhikrā, Agni, and the divine Uṣas, Bṛhaspati and the god Savitṛ, the two Aśvins, Mitra-Varuṇa, Bhaga, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas — these I invoke here.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ no̍ ya̱jñam a̱mṛte̍ṣu dhehī̱mā ha̱vyā jā̍tavedo juṣasva | sto̱kānā̍m agne̱ meda̍so ghṛ̱tasya̱ hota̱ḥ prāśā̍na pratha̱mo ni̱ṣadya̍ ||
english: Place this our sacrifice among the immortals; O Jātavedas, accept these oblations. O Agni, eat first, O Hotṛ, seating yourself, the drops of marrow and of ghee.

sanskrit: ghṛ̱tava̍ntaḥ pāvaka te sto̱kāḥ śco̍tanti̱ meda̍saḥ | svadha̍rman de̱vavī̍taye̱ śreṣṭha̍ṁ no dhehi̱ vārya̍m ||
english: O Pāvaka, drops full of ghee, drops of fat, trickle down for you. Following your own law, for the pleasure of the gods, bestow upon us the choicest boon.

sanskrit: tubhya̍ṁ sto̱kā ghṛ̍ta̱ścuto 'gne̱ viprā̍ya santya | ṛṣi̱ḥ śreṣṭha̱ḥ sam i̍dhyase ya̱jñasya̍ prāvi̱tā bha̍va ||
english: For you, O Agni, O inspired one, the ghee-dripping drops are truly meant. You are kindled as the foremost seer; be the promoter of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tubhya̍ṁ ścotanty adhrigo śacīvaḥ sto̱kāso̍ agne̱ meda̍so ghṛ̱tasya̍ | ka̱vi̱śa̱sto bṛ̍ha̱tā bhā̱nunāgā̍ ha̱vyā ju̍ṣasva medhira ||
english: For you, O inexhaustible, O powerful one, the drops of fat and ghee drip down, O Agni. You whom the seers have praised, come with your great radiance; O wise one, accept these oblations.

sanskrit: oji̍ṣṭhaṁ te madhya̱to meda̱ udbhṛ̍ta̱m pra te̍ va̱yaṁ da̍dāmahe | ścota̍nti te vaso sto̱kā adhi̍ tva̱ci prati̱ tān de̍va̱śo vi̍hi ||
english: The strongest fat, lifted out from the middle, we offer forward to you. O Vasu, the drops trickle upon your skin; receive them in a godly manner, distributing them as a god.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ so a̱gnir yasmi̱n soma̱m indra̍ḥ su̱taṁ da̱dhe ja̱ṭhare̍ vāvaśā̱naḥ | sa̱ha̱sriṇa̱ṁ vāja̱m atya̱ṁ na sapti̍ṁ sasa̱vān san stū̍yase jātavedaḥ ||
english: This is that Agni in whom Indra, bellowing, placed the pressed Soma in his belly. Winning a thousandfold prize like a racing steed, you are praised, O Jātavedas, while ever victorious.

sanskrit: agne̱ yat te̍ di̱vi varca̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyāṁ yad oṣa̍dhīṣv a̱psv ā ya̍jatra | yenā̱ntari̍kṣam u̱rv ā̍ta̱tantha̍ tve̱ṣaḥ sa bhā̱nur a̍rṇa̱vo nṛ̱cakṣā̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, O adorable one, whatever brilliance you have in heaven, on earth, in the plants and in the waters, by which you have stretched out broadly through the mid-air — that fierce, far-seeing, flood-like radiance is yours.

sanskrit: agne̍ di̱vo arṇa̱m acchā̍ jigā̱sy acchā̍ de̱vām̐ ū̍ciṣe̱ dhiṣṇyā̱ ye | yā ro̍ca̱ne pa̱rastā̱t sūrya̍sya̱ yāś cā̱vastā̍d upa̱tiṣṭha̍nta̱ āpa̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, you strive toward the flood of heaven; you call upon the gods who are the bright ones. The waters that stand beyond the luminous realm of the sun, and those that stand below — those you address.

sanskrit: pu̱rī̱ṣyā̍so a̱gnaya̍ḥ prāva̱ṇebhi̍ḥ sa̱joṣa̍saḥ | ju̱ṣantā̍ṁ ya̱jñam a̱druho̍ 'namī̱vā iṣo̍ ma̱hīḥ ||
english: The Agnis who dwell in strongholds, united in delight, flowing together in streams — may these guileless ones, free from malady, accept the sacrifice, the great refreshments.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, grant Iḷā of many feats and the ever-lasting winning of the cow to him who calls upon you. May there be for us a son, a male offspring; O Agni, may that good thought of yours be with us.

sanskrit: nirma̍thita̱ḥ sudhi̍ta̱ ā sa̱dhasthe̱ yuvā̍ ka̱vir a̍dhva̱rasya̍ praṇe̱tā | jūrya̍tsv a̱gnir a̱jaro̱ vane̱ṣv atrā̍ dadhe a̱mṛta̍ṁ jā̱tave̍dāḥ ||
english: Churned out, well-set in the ritual place, young, a seer, the guide of the ceremony — ageless Agni glowing among the kindling sticks; here Jātavedas has been established, immortal.

sanskrit: ama̍nthiṣṭā̱m bhāra̍tā re̱vad a̱gniṁ de̱vaśra̍vā de̱vavā̍taḥ su̱dakṣa̍m | agne̱ vi pa̍śya bṛha̱tābhi rā̱yeṣāṁ no̍ ne̱tā bha̍vatā̱d anu̱ dyūn ||
english: The two Bharatas, Devaśravā and Devavāta, churned forth Agni, rich, of excellent skill. O Agni, look out with your great light upon the riches; be our leader day after day.

sanskrit: daśa̱ kṣipa̍ḥ pū̱rvyaṁ sī̍m ajījana̱n sujā̍tam mā̱tṛṣu̍ pri̱yam | a̱gniṁ stu̍hi daivavā̱taṁ de̍vaśravo̱ yo janā̍nā̱m asa̍d va̱śī ||
english: Ten fingers generated him, the primordial one, well-born, dear to his mothers. Praise Agni, the Devavāta, O Devaśravas — he who shall be the lord of peoples.

sanskrit: ni tvā̍ dadhe̱ vara̱ ā pṛ̍thi̱vyā iḻā̍yās pa̱de su̍dina̱tve ahnā̍m | dṛ̱ṣadva̍tyā̱m mānu̍ṣa āpa̱yāyā̱ṁ sara̍svatyāṁ re̱vad a̍gne didīhi ||
english: I have set you down in the choicest place on earth, on the seat of Iḷā, in the bright time of days. On the Dṛṣadvatī, the Āpayā, and the Sarasvatī, O Agni, shine forth in your riches.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, grant Iḷā of many feats and the ever-lasting winning of cattle to him who calls upon you. May there be for us a son, a male offspring; O Agni, may that good thought of yours be with us.

sanskrit: agne̱ saha̍sva̱ pṛta̍nā a̱bhimā̍tī̱r apā̍sya | du̱ṣṭara̱s tara̱nn arā̍tī̱r varco̍ dhā ya̱jñavā̍hase ||
english: O Agni, overcome the hostile armies that press in upon us; drive them away. Crossing over those hard to cross, removing our enemies, place vigor in the bearer of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: agna̍ i̱ḻā sam i̍dhyase vī̱tiho̍tro̱ ama̍rtyaḥ | ju̱ṣasva̱ sū no̍ adhva̱ram ||
english: O Agni, you are kindled together with Iḷā, you who invite the gods to the feast, immortal one. Accept indeed our ceremony.

sanskrit: agne̍ dyu̱mnena̍ jāgṛve̱ saha̍saḥ sūnav āhuta | edam ba̱rhiḥ sa̍do̱ mama̍ ||
english: O Agni, ever wakeful with your glory, O son of strength, invoked with oblations — this is my seat of sacred grass.

sanskrit: agne̱ viśve̍bhir a̱gnibhi̍r de̱vebhi̍r mahayā̱ gira̍ḥ | ya̱jñeṣu̱ ya u̍ cā̱yava̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, with all the Agnis and the gods magnify our songs, those which are the devoted ones at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: agne̱ dā dā̱śuṣe̍ ra̱yiṁ vī̱rava̍nta̱m parī̍ṇasam | śi̱śī̱hi na̍ḥ sūnu̱mata̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, give to the devout worshipper wealth full of heroes and abounding in abundance; whet us to be rich in sons.

sanskrit: agne̍ di̱vaḥ sū̱nur a̍si̱ prace̍tā̱s tanā̍ pṛthi̱vyā u̱ta vi̱śvave̍dāḥ | ṛdha̍g de̱vām̐ i̱ha ya̍jā cikitvaḥ ||
english: O Agni, you are the son of heaven, the far-seeing; and also, continuously, of earth, the all-knowing. O wise one, worship the gods here separately.

sanskrit: a̱gniḥ sa̍noti vī̱ryā̍ṇi vi̱dvān sa̱noti̱ vāja̍m a̱mṛtā̍ya̱ bhūṣa̍n | sa no̍ de̱vām̐ eha va̍hā purukṣo ||
english: Agni, the knowing one, wins heroic powers; knowing, he wins strength, adorning himself for immortality. He, the abundant one, shall bring the gods here to us.

sanskrit: a̱gnir dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī vi̱śvaja̍nye̱ ā bhā̍ti de̱vī a̱mṛte̱ amū̍raḥ | kṣaya̱n vājai̍ḥ puruśca̱ndro namo̍bhiḥ ||
english: Agni shines in heaven and earth, for all peoples, divine, immortal, faultless. Abiding in prizes, of manifold splendor, with adorations.

sanskrit: agna̱ indra̍ś ca dā̱śuṣo̍ duro̱ṇe su̱tāva̍to ya̱jñam i̱hopa̍ yātam | ama̍rdhantā soma̱peyā̍ya devā ||
english: O Agni and Indra, come here to the sacrifice in the house of the worshipper who has pressed the Soma, to the one who gives. O gods, come together without hindrance to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: agne̍ a̱pāṁ sam i̍dhyase duro̱ṇe nitya̍ḥ sūno sahaso jātavedaḥ | sa̱dhasthā̍ni ma̱haya̍māna ū̱tī ||
english: O Agni, you are kindled together with the waters in the house, eternal, O son of strength, O Jātavedas. Magnifying the ritual stations with your protection.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱ram mana̍sā̱gniṁ ni̱cāyyā̍ ha̱viṣma̍nto anuṣa̱tyaṁ sva̱rvida̍m | su̱dānu̍ṁ de̱vaṁ ra̍thi̱raṁ va̍sū̱yavo̍ gī̱rbhī ra̱ṇvaṁ ku̍śi̱kāso̍ havāmahe ||
english: Meditating upon Vaiśvānara Agni, the ever-present, the finder of heaven — we who hold oblations, desiring wealth, we the Kuśikas invoke with our hymns the good-giving, joyful god, the charioteer.

sanskrit: taṁ śu̱bhram a̱gnim ava̍se havāmahe vaiśvāna̱ram mā̍ta̱riśvā̍nam u̱kthya̍m | bṛha̱spati̱m manu̍ṣo de̱vatā̍taye̱ vipra̱ṁ śrotā̍ra̱m ati̍thiṁ raghu̱ṣyada̍m ||
english: For protection we invoke that bright Agni, the Vaiśvānara, Mātariśvan, worthy of hymns — Bṛhaspati, the inspired listener, for the divine troop of man; the guest who is quickly pleased.

sanskrit: aśvo̱ na kranda̱ñ jani̍bhi̱ḥ sam i̍dhyate vaiśvāna̱raḥ ku̍śi̱kebhi̍r yu̱ge-yu̍ge | sa no̍ a̱gniḥ su̱vīrya̱ṁ svaśvya̱ṁ dadhā̍tu̱ ratna̍m a̱mṛte̍ṣu̱ jāgṛ̍viḥ ||
english: Neighing like a horse, Vaiśvānara is kindled by the Kuśikas age after age. May that Agni, ever wakeful among the immortals, bestow on us heroic might, good horses, and a jewel.

sanskrit: pra ya̍ntu̱ vājā̱s tavi̍ṣībhir a̱gnaya̍ḥ śu̱bhe sammi̍ślā̱ḥ pṛṣa̍tīr ayukṣata | bṛ̱ha̱dukṣo̍ ma̱ruto̍ vi̱śvave̍dasa̱ḥ pra ve̍payanti̱ parva̍tā̱m̐ adā̍bhyāḥ ||
english: Let the vigorous Agnis go forward with their might; the speckled mares have been yoked to the splendid array. The great-watered, all-knowing Maruts, irresistible, shake the mountains as they drive forward.

sanskrit: a̱gni̱śriyo̍ ma̱ruto̍ vi̱śvakṛ̍ṣṭaya̱ ā tve̱ṣam u̱gram ava̍ īmahe va̱yam | te svā̱nino̍ ru̱driyā̍ va̱rṣani̍rṇijaḥ si̱ṁhā na he̱ṣakra̍tavaḥ su̱dāna̍vaḥ ||
english: We seek the protection of the Maruts who bear Agni's glory, who rule over all peoples, fierce and terrible. They who roar, the sons of Rudra, robed in rain, like lions with neighing resolve, good givers.

sanskrit: vrāta̍ṁ-vrātaṁ ga̱ṇaṁ-ga̍ṇaṁ suśa̱stibhi̍r a̱gner bhāma̍m ma̱rutā̱m oja̍ īmahe | pṛṣa̍daśvāso anava̱bhrarā̍dhaso̱ gantā̍ro ya̱jñaṁ vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ dhīrā̍ḥ ||
english: Band after band, troop after troop, with our praises we seek Agni's fierceness and the Maruts' might. They who have speckled horses, of undiminished generosity, the wise ones who come to the sacrifice at the assemblies.

sanskrit: a̱gnir a̍smi̱ janma̍nā jā̱tave̍dā ghṛ̱tam me̱ cakṣu̍r a̱mṛta̍m ma ā̱san | a̱rkas tri̱dhātū̱ raja̍so vi̱māno 'ja̍sro gha̱rmo ha̱vir a̍smi̱ nāma̍ ||
english: By birth I am Agni, Jātavedas; ghee is my eye, immortality is in my mouth. The song of praise, the three-composed measurer of the atmosphere — the undying warmth — oblation is my name.

sanskrit: tri̱bhiḥ pa̱vitrai̱r apu̍po̱d dhy a1̱̍rkaṁ hṛ̱dā ma̱tiṁ jyoti̱r anu̍ prajā̱nan | varṣi̍ṣṭha̱ṁ ratna̍m akṛta sva̱dhābhi̱r ād id dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī pary a̍paśyat ||
english: With three purifying filters he has purified the hymn, knowing the light, following his thought in his heart. He has made the highest jewel by his own power; then heaven and earth looked around upon it.

sanskrit: śa̱tadhā̍ra̱m utsa̱m akṣī̍yamāṇaṁ vipa̱ścita̍m pi̱tara̱ṁ vaktvā̍nām | me̱ḻim mada̍ntam pi̱tror u̱pasthe̱ taṁ ro̍dasī pipṛtaṁ satya̱vāca̍m ||
english: The spring of a hundred streams, inexhaustible, the wise father of utterances, the joyfully intoxicated virile one in the lap of his two parents — O heaven and earth, fill that truth-speaking one.

sanskrit: pra vo̱ vājā̍ a̱bhidya̍vo ha̱viṣma̍nto ghṛ̱tācyā̍ | de̱vāñ ji̍gāti sumna̱yuḥ ||
english: The vigorous ones, aiming at heaven, with oblations, gleaming with ghee — the well-wisher goes forth to the gods.

sanskrit: īḻe̍ a̱gniṁ vi̍pa̱ścita̍ṁ gi̱rā ya̱jñasya̱ sādha̍nam | śru̱ṣṭī̱vāna̍ṁ dhi̱tāvā̍nam ||
english: I praise Agni the all-seeing with song, the accomplisher of the sacrifice, the one who listens obediently, the one rich in devotion.

sanskrit: agne̍ śa̱kema̍ te va̱yaṁ yama̍ṁ de̱vasya̍ vā̱jina̍ḥ | ati̱ dveṣā̍ṁsi tarema ||
english: O Agni, may we be capable of your control, O divine, vigorous one; may we cross beyond our hatreds.

sanskrit: sa̱mi̱dhyamā̍no adhva̱re̱3̱̍ 'gniḥ pā̍va̱ka īḍya̍ḥ | śo̱ciṣke̍śa̱s tam ī̍mahe ||
english: Agni, the purifier, being kindled at the ceremony, worthy of praise — flame-haired, we seek him.

sanskrit: pṛ̱thu̱pājā̱ ama̍rtyo ghṛ̱tani̍rṇi̱k svā̍hutaḥ | a̱gnir ya̱jñasya̍ havya̱vāṭ ||
english: Of broad brilliance, immortal, robed in ghee, well-offered with oblations — Agni is the carrier of the oblations of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: taṁ sa̱bādho̍ ya̱tasru̍ca i̱tthā dhi̱yā ya̱jñava̍ntaḥ | ā ca̍krur a̱gnim ū̱taye̍ ||
english: Those pressed from all sides, who stretch out the ladle, thus in their thought, those who possess the sacrifice — they have invoked Agni for protection.

sanskrit: hotā̍ de̱vo ama̍rtyaḥ pu̱rastā̍d eti mā̱yayā̍ | vi̱dathā̍ni praco̱daya̍n ||
english: The divine Hotṛ, immortal, goes ahead with his wisdom, impelling the assemblies.

sanskrit: vā̱jī vāje̍ṣu dhīyate 'dhva̱reṣu̱ pra ṇī̍yate | vipro̍ ya̱jñasya̱ sādha̍naḥ ||
english: The vigorous one is set among the prizes, led forward at the ceremonies; the inspired one is the accomplisher of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: dhi̱yā ca̍kre̱ vare̍ṇyo bhū̱tānā̱ṁ garbha̱m ā da̍dhe | dakṣa̍sya pi̱tara̱ṁ tanā̍ ||
english: The excellent one has acted through inspiration; he has set the embryo of all beings. Continuously the father of Dakṣa.

sanskrit: ni tvā̍ dadhe̱ vare̍ṇya̱ṁ dakṣa̍sye̱ḻā sa̍haskṛta | agne̍ sudī̱tim u̱śija̍m ||
english: I set you down, the excellent one, as Iḷā of Dakṣa, made mighty, O Agni, of bright luster, eager.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ ya̱ntura̍m a̱ptura̍m ṛ̱tasya̱ yoge̍ va̱nuṣa̍ḥ | viprā̱ vājai̱ḥ sam i̍ndhate ||
english: The inspired ones kindle together with prizes Agni, the controller, the mover in the waters, winning at the harnessing of truth.

sanskrit: ū̱rjo napā̍tam adhva̱re dī̍di̱vāṁsa̱m upa̱ dyavi̍ | a̱gnim ī̍ḻe ka̱vikra̍tum ||
english: I praise at the ceremony Agni, the grandson of strength, shining, near the day, of sage resolve.

sanskrit: ī̱ḻenyo̍ nama̱sya̍s ti̱ras tamā̍ṁsi darśa̱taḥ | sam a̱gnir i̍dhyate̱ vṛṣā̍ ||
english: Worthy of praise, worthy of reverence, visible through the darknesses — the bull Agni is kindled together.

sanskrit: vṛṣo̍ a̱gniḥ sam i̍dhya̱te 'śvo̱ na de̍va̱vāha̍naḥ | taṁ ha̱viṣma̍nta īḻate ||
english: The bull Agni is kindled, the divine carrier of gods like a horse; those who hold oblations praise him.

sanskrit: vṛṣa̍ṇaṁ tvā va̱yaṁ vṛ̍ṣa̱n vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ḥ sam i̍dhīmahi | agne̱ dīdya̍tam bṛ̱hat ||
english: O bull, as bulls we kindle you, the virile one, O virile one; O Agni, shine out your great brightness.

sanskrit: agne̍ ju̱ṣasva̍ no ha̱viḥ pu̍ro̱ḻāśa̍ṁ jātavedaḥ | prā̱ta̱ḥsā̱ve dhi̍yāvaso ||
english: O Agni, O Jātavedas, accept our oblation, the sacrificial cake, at the morning pressing; O you rich in devotion.

sanskrit: pu̱ro̱ḻā a̍gne paca̱tas tubhya̍ṁ vā ghā̱ pari̍ṣkṛtaḥ | taṁ ju̍ṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
english: O Agni, the sacrificial cake cooked and prepared is indeed for you alone. Accept it, O youngest one.

sanskrit: agne̍ vī̱hi pu̍ro̱ḻāśa̱m āhu̍taṁ ti̱roa̍hnyam | saha̍saḥ sū̱nur a̍sy adhva̱re hi̱taḥ ||
english: O Agni, eat the sacrificial cake offered, that which passes beyond the day. You are the son of strength, established at the ceremony.

sanskrit: mādhya̍ṁdine̱ sava̍ne jātavedaḥ puro̱ḻāśa̍m i̱ha ka̍ve juṣasva | agne̍ ya̱hvasya̱ tava̍ bhāga̱dheya̱ṁ na pra mi̍nanti vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ dhīrā̍ḥ ||
english: O Jātavedas, O wise one, at the midday pressing, accept here the sacrificial cake. O Agni, the wise ones at the assemblies do not diminish your due portion as the swift one.

sanskrit: agne̍ tṛ̱tīye̱ sava̍ne̱ hi kāni̍ṣaḥ puro̱ḻāśa̍ṁ sahasaḥ sūna̱v āhu̍tam | athā̍ de̱veṣv a̍dhva̱raṁ vi̍pa̱nyayā̱ dhā ratna̍vantam a̱mṛte̍ṣu̱ jāgṛ̍vim ||
english: O Agni, you desire the sacrificial cake offered at the third pressing, O son of strength. Then, with wonder, establish among the gods a ceremony that is rich in jewels, wakeful among the immortals.

sanskrit: agne̍ vṛdhā̱na āhu̍tim puro̱ḻāśa̍ṁ jātavedaḥ | ju̱ṣasva̍ ti̱roa̍hnyam ||
english: O Agni, O Jātavedas, growing with the oblation — accept the sacrificial cake that passes beyond the day.

sanskrit: astī̱dam a̍dhi̱mantha̍na̱m asti̍ pra̱jana̍naṁ kṛ̱tam | e̱tāṁ vi̱śpatnī̱m ā bha̍rā̱gnim ma̍nthāma pū̱rvathā̍ ||
english: Here is the upper fire-drill, the procreative one is fashioned. Bring that lady of the folk — we shall churn Agni as in ancient times.

sanskrit: a̱raṇyo̱r nihi̍to jā̱tave̍dā̱ garbha̍ iva̱ sudhi̍to ga̱rbhiṇī̍ṣu | di̱ve-di̍va̱ īḍyo̍ jāgṛ̱vadbhi̍r ha̱viṣma̍dbhir manu̱ṣye̍bhir a̱gniḥ ||
english: Jātavedas is hidden in the two fire-sticks, like an embryo well-placed in pregnant women. Agni is to be praised day after day by the watchful, oblation-bearing men.

sanskrit: u̱ttā̱nāyā̱m ava̍ bharā ciki̱tvān sa̱dyaḥ pravī̍tā̱ vṛṣa̍ṇaṁ jajāna | a̱ru̱ṣastū̍po̱ ruśa̍d asya̱ pāja̱ iḻā̍yās pu̱tro va̱yune̍ 'janiṣṭa ||
english: Bring him down into the outstretched one — the wise knowing one instantly excited, has generated the virile one. The bright-streaked one whose brilliance is reddish — the son of Iḷā was born at the meeting-place.

sanskrit: iḻā̍yās tvā pa̱de va̱yaṁ nābhā̍ pṛthi̱vyā adhi̍ | jāta̍vedo̱ ni dhī̍ma̱hy agne̍ ha̱vyāya̱ voḻha̍ve ||
english: We place you, O Jātavedas, O Agni, in the seat of Iḷā, at the navel of the earth, for the carrying of oblations.

sanskrit: mantha̍tā naraḥ ka̱vim adva̍yanta̱m prace̍tasam a̱mṛta̍ṁ su̱pratī̍kam | ya̱jñasya̍ ke̱tum pra̍tha̱mam pu̱rastā̍d a̱gniṁ na̍ro janayatā su̱śeva̍m ||
english: O men, churn him — the seer, the straightforward, the far-seeing, the immortal, the fair-faced; O men, generate Agni the auspicious, first banner of the sacrifice, in the east.

sanskrit: yadī̱ mantha̍nti bā̱hubhi̱r vi ro̍ca̱te 'śvo̱ na vā̱jy a̍ru̱ṣo vane̱ṣv ā | ci̱tro na yāma̍nn a̱śvino̱r ani̍vṛta̱ḥ pari̍ vṛṇa̱kty aśma̍na̱s tṛṇā̱ daha̍n ||
english: When they churn with their arms, he shines forth, red as a swift horse in the forests. Brilliant as the track of the two Aśvins, unrestricted in his motion, he twists around the stones, burning the grass.

sanskrit: jā̱to a̱gnī ro̍cate̱ ceki̍tāno vā̱jī vipra̍ḥ kaviśa̱staḥ su̱dānu̍ḥ | yaṁ de̱vāsa̱ īḍya̍ṁ viśva̱vida̍ṁ havya̱vāha̱m ada̍dhur adhva̱reṣu̍ ||
english: Born, Agni shines, all-perceiving, vigorous, inspired, praised by the poet, good-giving. Whom the gods, praising him, the all-knowing carrier of oblations, have established at the ceremonies.

sanskrit: sīda̍ hota̱ḥ sva u̍ lo̱ke ci̍ki̱tvān sā̱dayā̍ ya̱jñaṁ su̍kṛ̱tasya̱ yonau̍ | de̱vā̱vīr de̱vān ha̱viṣā̍ yajā̱sy agne̍ bṛ̱had yaja̍māne̱ vayo̍ dhāḥ ||
english: Sit down, O Hotṛ, in your own realm, knowing; establish the sacrifice in the womb of the well-performed rite. You, the friend of the gods, worship the gods with oblations, O Agni; place great vitality in the worshipper.

sanskrit: kṛ̱ṇota̍ dhū̱maṁ vṛṣa̍ṇaṁ sakhā̱yo 'sre̍dhanta itana̱ vāja̱m accha̍ | a̱yam a̱gniḥ pṛ̍tanā̱ṣāṭ su̱vīro̱ yena̍ de̱vāso̱ asa̍hanta̱ dasyū̍n ||
english: O companions, make the smoke virile; go without stumbling toward the prize. This Agni conquers in battle, of good heroes, by whom the gods overcame the Dasyus.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ te̱ yoni̍r ṛ̱tviyo̱ yato̍ jā̱to aro̍cathāḥ | taṁ jā̱nann a̍gna̱ ā sī̱dāthā̍ no vardhayā̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: This is your womb fitting to the season, from which, born, you shone. Knowing it, O Agni, sit down here; then magnify our songs.

sanskrit: tanū̱napā̍d ucyate̱ garbha̍ āsu̱ro narā̱śaṁso̍ bhavati̱ yad vi̱jāya̍te | mā̱ta̱riśvā̱ yad ami̍mīta mā̱tari̱ vāta̍sya̱ sargo̍ abhava̱t sarī̍maṇi ||
english: He is called Tanūnapāt the embryo, the supernatural — Narāśaṁsa he becomes when he is generated. When Mātariśvan measured him in the mother, the current of wind arose in his going.

sanskrit: su̱ni̱rmathā̱ nirma̍thitaḥ suni̱dhā nihi̍taḥ ka̱viḥ | agne̍ svadhva̱rā kṛ̍ṇu de̱vān de̍vaya̱te ya̍ja ||
english: Well churned out, churned; well established, set down — the seer. O Agni, perform the good ceremony; worship the gods for the one who desires the gods.

sanskrit: ajī̍janann a̱mṛta̱m martyā̍so 'sre̱māṇa̍ṁ ta̱raṇi̍ṁ vī̱ḻuja̍mbham | daśa̱ svasā̍ro a̱gruva̍ḥ samī̱cīḥ pumā̍ṁsaṁ jā̱tam a̱bhi saṁ ra̍bhante ||
english: Mortals have generated the immortal, the unhesitating, swift one of firm jaws. The ten sisters, the maidens who move together, embrace the male that is born.

sanskrit: pra sa̱ptaho̍tā sana̱kād a̍rocata mā̱tur u̱pasthe̱ yad aśo̍ca̱d ūdha̍ni | na ni mi̍ṣati su̱raṇo̍ di̱ve-di̍ve̱ yad asu̍rasya ja̱ṭharā̱d ajā̍yata ||
english: The seven-Hotṛ one shone forth from of old when he shone at the udder in the mother's lap. The joyful, well-pleased one does not close his eyes day after day — he who was born from the belly of the Asura.

sanskrit: a̱mi̱trā̱yudho̍ ma̱rutā̍m iva pra̱yāḥ pra̍thama̱jā brahma̍ṇo̱ viśva̱m id vi̍duḥ | dyu̱mnava̱d brahma̍ kuśi̱kāsa̱ eri̍ra̱ eka̍-eko̱ dame̍ a̱gniṁ sam ī̍dhire ||
english: Like the outgoings of the Maruts with their weapons for enemies, the firstborn of the prayer know everything. The Kuśikas have sent forth glorious prayer; each in his own house has kindled Agni.

sanskrit: yad a̱dya tvā̍ praya̱ti ya̱jñe a̱smin hota̍ś ciki̱tvo 'vṛ̍ṇīmahī̱ha | dhru̱vam a̍yā dhru̱vam u̱tāśa̍miṣṭhāḥ prajā̱nan vi̱dvām̐ upa̍ yāhi̱ soma̍m ||
english: Today, as this sacrifice proceeds, we have chosen you here, O wise Hotṛ, knowing. Going firmly, firmly and most swiftly, knowing, all-wise, come to the Soma.

sanskrit: i̱cchanti̍ tvā so̱myāsa̱ḥ sakhā̍yaḥ su̱nvanti̱ soma̱ṁ dadha̍ti̱ prayā̍ṁsi | titi̍kṣante a̱bhiśa̍sti̱ṁ janā̍nā̱m indra̱ tvad ā kaś ca̱na hi pra̍ke̱taḥ ||
english: The Soma-pressing friends desire you; they press the Soma, they set out the offerings. They endure the curse of men — O Indra, whoever has true discernment comes from you alone.

sanskrit: na te̍ dū̱re pa̍ra̱mā ci̱d rajā̱ṁsy ā tu pra yā̍hi harivo̱ hari̍bhyām | sthi̱rāya̱ vṛṣṇe̱ sava̍nā kṛ̱temā yu̱ktā grāvā̍ṇaḥ samidhā̱ne a̱gnau ||
english: Not even the farthest realms are far for you; come here, O lord of bay horses, with your bay steeds. The pressings are made for the steady bull; the pressing stones are set in motion as Agni blazes.

sanskrit: indra̍ḥ su̱śipro̍ ma̱ghavā̱ taru̍tro ma̱hāvrā̍tas tuvikū̱rmir ṛghā̍vān | yad u̱gro dhā bā̍dhi̱to martye̍ṣu̱ kva1̱̍ tyā te̍ vṛṣabha vī̱ryā̍ṇi ||
english: Indra of the beautiful jaw, the bountiful, the conqueror, of great vows, of manifold activity, impetuous — when you, the fierce one, are hard-pressed among mortals, where then are those heroic powers of yours, O bull?

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi ṣmā̍ cyā̱vaya̱nn acyu̍tā̱ny eko̍ vṛ̱trā cara̍si̱ jighna̍mānaḥ | tava̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī parva̍tā̱so 'nu̍ vra̱tāya̱ nimi̍teva tasthuḥ ||
english: For you alone, shaking even the unshakeable things, go about slaying the Vṛtras. Heaven, earth, and mountains stand fixed as if nailed down, obedient to your decree.

sanskrit: u̱tābha̍ye puruhūta̱ śravo̍bhi̱r eko̍ dṛ̱ḻham a̍vado vṛtra̱hā san | i̱me ci̍d indra̱ roda̍sī apā̱re yat sa̍ṁgṛ̱bhṇā ma̍ghavan kā̱śir it te̍ ||
english: And in both the fearful realms, O much-invoked, with your glories, you alone, being the Vṛtra-slayer, have spoken firmly. Even these two boundless worlds, O Indra — that which is visible, O bountiful, is the gleam of you.

sanskrit: pra sū ta̍ indra pra̱vatā̱ hari̍bhyā̱m pra te̱ vajra̍ḥ pramṛ̱ṇann e̍tu̱ śatrū̍n | ja̱hi pra̍tī̱co a̍nū̱caḥ parā̍co̱ viśva̍ṁ sa̱tyaṁ kṛ̍ṇuhi vi̱ṣṭam a̍stu ||
english: Go forth, O Indra, downward with your bay horses; let your thunderbolt go forward grinding the enemies. Strike those facing us, those following behind, those fleeing — make everything truly victorious.

sanskrit: yasmai̱ dhāyu̱r ada̍dhā̱ martyā̱yābha̍ktaṁ cid bhajate ge̱hya1̱̍ṁ saḥ | bha̱drā ta̍ indra suma̱tir ghṛ̱tācī̍ sa̱hasra̍dānā puruhūta rā̱tiḥ ||
english: The mortal for whom you, the milk-bearing one, set down even what was unshared — he enjoys what is to be enjoyed in the house. Benevolent is your good thought, O Indra, gleaming with ghee, your thousandfold gift, O much-invoked.

sanskrit: sa̱hadā̍num puruhūta kṣi̱yanta̍m aha̱stam i̍ndra̱ sam pi̍ṇa̱k kuṇā̍rum | a̱bhi vṛ̱traṁ vardha̍māna̱m piyā̍rum a̱pāda̍m indra ta̱vasā̍ jaghantha ||
english: O much-invoked one, you crushed together Sahadānu, the dweller who has no hands, O Indra — Kuṇāru. O Indra, you slew with might Vṛtra the grower, the mocker without feet.

sanskrit: ni sā̍ma̱nām i̍ṣi̱rām i̍ndra̱ bhūmi̍m ma̱hīm a̍pā̱rāṁ sada̍ne sasattha | asta̍bhnā̱d dyāṁ vṛ̍ṣa̱bho a̱ntari̍kṣa̱m arṣa̱ntv āpa̱s tvaye̱ha prasū̍tāḥ ||
english: O Indra, you have lain down in the abode of the swift, great, boundless earth. The bull has propped up heaven and the atmosphere; may the waters, impelled by you, flow here.

sanskrit: a̱lā̱tṛ̱ṇo va̱la i̍ndra vra̱jo goḥ pu̱rā hanto̱r bhaya̍māno̱ vy ā̍ra | su̱gān pa̱tho a̍kṛṇon ni̱raje̱ gāḥ prāva̱n vāṇī̍ḥ puruhū̱taṁ dhama̍ntīḥ ||
english: Vala, not a feeder, the cow-pen — before the striker, fearing, he opened it. He made the paths easy, driving out the cows; the voices blowing supported the much-invoked Indra.

sanskrit: eko̱ dve vasu̍matī samī̱cī indra̱ ā pa̍prau pṛthi̱vīm u̱ta dyām | u̱tāntari̍kṣād a̱bhi na̍ḥ samī̱ka i̱ṣo ra̱thīḥ sa̱yuja̍ḥ śūra̱ vājā̍n ||
english: The one with two — the pair rich in wealth joining together, O Indra, fills earth and sky. And from the mid-air, the joining is toward us, O hero — the chariot-lord's refreshments, the yoked prizes.

sanskrit: diśa̱ḥ sūryo̱ na mi̍nāti̱ pradi̍ṣṭā di̱ve-di̍ve̱ harya̍śvaprasūtāḥ | saṁ yad āna̱ḻ adhva̍na̱ ād id aśvai̍r vi̱moca̍naṁ kṛṇute̱ tat tv a̍sya ||
english: The quarters pointed out — as the sun does not diminish them — day after day, impelled by the bay-horsed one; when he reached the paths, then immediately he unharnesses his horses — that is its loosening.

sanskrit: didṛ̍kṣanta u̱ṣaso̱ yāma̍nn a̱ktor vi̱vasva̍tyā̱ mahi̍ ci̱tram anī̍kam | viśve̍ jānanti mahi̱nā yad āgā̱d indra̍sya̱ karma̱ sukṛ̍tā pu̱rūṇi̍ ||
english: Desiring to see, at the going of dawn, at the night, the great manifold army of Vivasvat — all know, when he came in his greatness, the many well-performed deeds of Indra.

sanskrit: mahi̱ jyoti̱r nihi̍taṁ va̱kṣaṇā̍sv ā̱mā pa̱kvaṁ ca̍rati̱ bibhra̍tī̱ gauḥ | viśva̱ṁ svādma̱ sambhṛ̍tam u̱sriyā̍yā̱ṁ yat sī̱m indro̱ ada̍dhā̱d bhoja̍nāya ||
english: A great light is placed in her flanks; the cow wanders carrying both raw and cooked. All savory food gathered in the dawn-cow, which Indra deposited in her for enjoyment.

sanskrit: indra̱ dṛhya̍ yāmako̱śā a̍bhūvan ya̱jñāya̍ śikṣa gṛṇa̱te sakhi̍bhyaḥ | du̱rmā̱yavo̍ du̱revā̱ martyā̍so niṣa̱ṅgiṇo̍ ri̱pavo̱ hantvā̍saḥ ||
english: O Indra, be firm — the treasury-keepers of the roads have arisen; instruct the singer and his companions for the sacrifice. The evil-minded ones of bad deeds, the mortals who carry swords, the enemies — may they be struck down.

sanskrit: saṁ ghoṣa̍ḥ śṛṇve 'va̱mair a̱mitrai̍r ja̱hī ny e̍ṣv a̱śani̱ṁ tapi̍ṣṭhām | vṛ̱ścem a̱dhastā̱d vi ru̍jā̱ saha̍sva ja̱hi rakṣo̍ maghavan ra̱ndhaya̍sva ||
english: The roar is heard with those who attack from below, the enemies. Cast down upon these your most burning thunderbolt. Break them off below and crush them; slay the Rakṣas, O bountiful, subdue them.

sanskrit: ud vṛ̍ha̱ rakṣa̍ḥ sa̱hamū̍lam indra vṛ̱śca madhya̱m praty agra̍ṁ śṛṇīhi | ā kīva̍taḥ sala̱lūka̍ṁ cakartha brahma̱dviṣe̱ tapu̍ṣiṁ he̱tim a̍sya ||
english: Root out the Rakṣas together with its roots, O Indra; cut it in the middle, cut the top piece off. You have made the stingy one, the owl-resembler, a target; fling the burning weapon against the prayer-hater.

sanskrit: sva̱staye̍ vā̱jibhi̍ś ca praṇeta̱ḥ saṁ yan ma̱hīr iṣa̍ ā̱satsi̍ pū̱rvīḥ | rā̱yo va̱ntāro̍ bṛha̱taḥ syā̍mā̱sme a̍stu̱ bhaga̍ indra pra̱jāvā̍n ||
english: For well-being, O leader with the vigorous ones, when you have sat down with the many great refreshments — may we be winners of great riches; may there be with us wealth with progeny, O Indra.

sanskrit: ā no̍ bhara̱ bhaga̍m indra dyu̱manta̱ṁ ni te̍ de̱ṣṇasya̍ dhīmahi prare̱ke | ū̱rva i̍va paprathe̱ kāmo̍ a̱sme tam ā pṛ̍ṇa vasupate̱ vasū̍nām ||
english: Bring us resplendent good fortune, O Indra; we reflect upon your gift abundantly. Our desire has spread out as the large cattle enclosure; fill it up, O lord of goods, among all goods.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ kāma̍m mandayā̱ gobhi̱r aśvai̍ś ca̱ndrava̍tā̱ rādha̍sā pa̱pratha̍ś ca | sva̱ryavo̍ ma̱tibhi̱s tubhya̱ṁ viprā̱ indrā̍ya̱ vāha̍ḥ kuśi̱kāso̍ akran ||
english: Gladden this desire with cows and horses, with bright generosity, and spread it wide. Striving toward heaven, the inspired ones have made their thoughts a chariot for Indra — thus the Kuśikas have cried out.

sanskrit: ā no̍ go̱trā da̍rdṛhi gopate̱ gāḥ sam a̱smabhya̍ṁ sa̱nayo̍ yantu̱ vājā̍ḥ | di̱vakṣā̍ asi vṛṣabha sa̱tyaśu̍ṣmo̱ 'smabhya̱ṁ su ma̍ghavan bodhi go̱dāḥ ||
english: Break open for us the cow-pens, O lord of cattle; let the prizes and ancient winnings come together to us. You are the heavenly shaker, O bull of true vigor; O bountiful one, be a giver of cows to us.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: For good fortune let us call the bountiful Indra, the most heroic in this battle for the prize; the fierce one who hears, for protection in the fights, who slays the Vṛtras, the conqueror of riches.

sanskrit: śāsa̱d vahni̍r duhi̱tur na̱ptya̍ṁ gād vi̱dvām̐ ṛ̱tasya̱ dīdhi̍tiṁ sapa̱ryan | pi̱tā yatra̍ duhi̱tuḥ seka̍m ṛ̱ñjan saṁ śa̱gmye̍na̱ mana̍sā dadha̱nve ||
english: The carrier of offerings will instruct the daughter's son, going knowing, honoring the shining of truth. Where the father, mingling the emission of the daughter, combined them with a willing mind.

sanskrit: na jā̱maye̱ tānvo̍ ri̱ktham ā̍raik ca̱kāra̱ garbha̍ṁ sani̱tur ni̱dhāna̍m | yadī̍ mā̱taro̍ ja̱naya̍nta̱ vahni̍m a̱nyaḥ ka̱rtā su̱kṛto̍r a̱nya ṛ̱ndhan ||
english: He did not leave the kinswomen an empty inheritance; he made his embryo the receptacle of the progenitor. When the mothers generated the carrier of offerings, one made it, another made the well-made thing to prosper.

sanskrit: a̱gnir ja̍jñe ju̱hvā̱3̱̍ reja̍māno ma̱has pu̱trām̐ a̍ru̱ṣasya̍ pra̱yakṣe̍ | ma̱hān garbho̱ mahy ā jā̱tam e̍ṣām ma̱hī pra̱vṛd dharya̍śvasya ya̱jñaiḥ ||
english: Agni was born trembling with his tongue at the great sacrifice of the red one's sons. The great embryo born greatly among them — great is the growth of the bay-horsed one through sacrifices.

sanskrit: a̱bhi jaitrī̍r asacanta spṛdhā̱nam mahi̱ jyoti̱s tama̍so̱ nir a̍jānan | taṁ jā̍na̱tīḥ praty ud ā̍yann u̱ṣāsa̱ḥ pati̱r gavā̍m abhava̱d eka̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: The victorious ones came together against the opponent; they brought forth great light from the darkness. The dawns, knowing him, rose toward him; Indra alone became the lord of the cows.

sanskrit: vī̱ḻau sa̱tīr a̱bhi dhīrā̍ atṛndan prā̱cāhi̍nva̱n mana̍sā sa̱pta viprā̍ḥ | viśvā̍m avindan pa̱thyā̍m ṛ̱tasya̍ prajā̱nann it tā nama̱sā vi̍veśa ||
english: The wise ones, the seven inspired ones, pressed through them even though hard, driving them eastward with their minds. They found all the paths of truth; knowing them indeed, he entered them with homage.

sanskrit: vi̱dad yadī̍ sa̱ramā̍ ru̱gṇam adre̱r mahi̱ pātha̍ḥ pū̱rvyaṁ sa̱dhrya̍k kaḥ | agra̍ṁ nayat su̱pady akṣa̍rāṇā̱m acchā̱ rava̍m pratha̱mā jā̍na̱tī gā̍t ||
english: When Saramā found the breach in the rock — who made that ancient great flood to flow properly together? She who went first toward the lowing, knowing, leading the front of the syllables — to the cows.

sanskrit: aga̍cchad u̱ vipra̍tamaḥ sakhī̱yann asū̍dayat su̱kṛte̱ garbha̱m adri̍ḥ | sa̱sāna̱ maryo̱ yuva̍bhir makha̱syann athā̍bhava̱d aṅgi̍rāḥ sa̱dyo arca̍n ||
english: The most inspired one came, desiring friendship; the rock yielded its embryo to the well-performed rite. The young man winning together with the young ones, exulting — then he became Aṅgiras, praising immediately.

sanskrit: sa̱taḥ-sa̍taḥ prati̱māna̍m puro̱bhūr viśvā̍ veda̱ jani̍mā̱ hanti̱ śuṣṇa̍m | pra ṇo̍ di̱vaḥ pa̍da̱vīr ga̱vyur arca̱n sakhā̱ sakhī̍m̐r amuñca̱n nir a̍va̱dyāt ||
english: Hundred by hundred he is the foreguard-counterpart, he knows all births, he smites Śuṣṇa. Singing, the path of heaven desiring cows for us, the friend freed the friends from disgrace.

sanskrit: ni ga̍vya̱tā mana̍sā sedur a̱rkaiḥ kṛ̍ṇvā̱nāso̍ amṛta̱tvāya̍ gā̱tum | i̱daṁ ci̱n nu sada̍na̱m bhūry e̍ṣā̱ṁ yena̱ māsā̱m̐ asi̍ṣāsann ṛ̱tena̍ ||
english: With a mind bent on cows they settled with their songs, making a path toward immortality. This indeed is now their rich abiding-place, by which, with truth, they aimed at the months.

sanskrit: sa̱mpaśya̍mānā amadann a̱bhi svam paya̍ḥ pra̱tnasya̱ reta̍so̱ dughā̍nāḥ | vi roda̍sī atapa̱d ghoṣa̍ eṣāṁ jā̱te ni̱ṣṭhām ada̍dhu̱r goṣu̍ vī̱rān ||
english: Looking upon each other, they rejoiced, milking their own milk of the primordial seed. Their voice blazed through heaven and earth; at his birth they placed the final goal: heroes among the cows.

sanskrit: sa jā̱tebhi̍r vṛtra̱hā sed u̍ ha̱vyair ud u̱sriyā̍ asṛja̱d indro̍ a̱rkaiḥ | u̱rū̱cy a̍smai ghṛ̱tava̱d bhara̍ntī̱ madhu̱ svādma̍ duduhe̱ jenyā̱ gauḥ ||
english: He, the Vṛtra-slayer, with those born, truly with oblations, Indra released the dawn-cows with songs. Bringing abundant ghee-rich food to him, the noble cow milked honey and sweet food.

sanskrit: pi̱tre ci̍c cakru̱ḥ sada̍na̱ṁ sam a̍smai̱ mahi̱ tviṣī̍mat su̱kṛto̱ vi hi khyan | vi̱ṣka̱bhnanta̱ḥ skambha̍nenā̱ jani̍trī̱ āsī̍nā ū̱rdhvaṁ ra̍bha̱saṁ vi mi̍nvan ||
english: They made a dwelling for the father too, with great flashing; the well-performed ones shone out distinctly. Propping up with a prop the two parents seated, spreading the swift, upward one.

sanskrit: ma̱hī yadi̍ dhi̱ṣaṇā̍ śi̱śnathe̱ dhāt sa̍dyo̱vṛdha̍ṁ vi̱bhva1̱̍ṁ roda̍syoḥ | giro̱ yasmi̍nn anava̱dyāḥ sa̍mī̱cīr viśvā̱ indrā̍ya̱ tavi̍ṣī̱r anu̍ttāḥ ||
english: If the great Dhiṣaṇā has stirred the instantly-growing, pervading one of the two worlds — the songs in whom are faultless, fitting together, all the powers unconquered for Indra.

sanskrit: mahy ā te̍ sa̱khyaṁ va̍śmi śa̱ktīr ā vṛ̍tra̱ghne ni̱yuto̍ yanti pū̱rvīḥ ||
english: I greatly desire your friendship, your powers; to the Vṛtra-slayer many teams of horses come. Great is the praise-song we have come to of the hero; O bountiful one, be well our guardian.

sanskrit: mahi̱ kṣetra̍m pu̱ru śca̱ndraṁ vi̍vi̱dvān ād it sakhi̍bhyaś ca̱ratha̱ṁ sam ai̍rat | indro̱ nṛbhi̍r ajana̱d dīdyā̍naḥ sā̱kaṁ sūrya̍m u̱ṣasa̍ṁ gā̱tum a̱gnim ||
english: Knowing the great field of manifold splendor, then he set the movement going for his companions. Indra shining, together with the men, generated simultaneously the sun, the dawn, the path, and fire.

sanskrit: a̱paś ci̍d e̱ṣa vi̱bhvo̱3̱̍ damū̍nā̱ḥ pra sa̱dhrīcī̍r asṛjad vi̱śvaśca̍ndrāḥ | madhva̍ḥ punā̱nāḥ ka̱vibhi̍ḥ pa̱vitrai̱r dyubhi̍r hinvanty a̱ktubhi̱r dhanu̍trīḥ ||
english: This pervading house-companion also set forth the waters all-together, of universal splendor. Purifying with the seers' filters of honey, the heavenly ones impel the arching ones by day and by night.

sanskrit: anu̍ kṛ̱ṣṇe vasu̍dhitī jihāte u̱bhe sūrya̍sya ma̱ṁhanā̱ yaja̍tre | pari̱ yat te̍ mahi̱māna̍ṁ vṛ̱jadhyai̱ sakhā̍ya indra̱ kāmyā̍ ṛji̱pyāḥ ||
english: Both treasure-keepers follow along the dark one; both are the generosity of the adorable sun. When your friends, O Indra, the straight-flying desirable ones, are to encircle your greatness.

sanskrit: pati̍r bhava vṛtrahan sū̱nṛtā̍nāṁ gi̱rāṁ vi̱śvāyu̍r vṛṣa̱bho va̍yo̱dhāḥ ||
english: Be lord of true words, O Vṛtra-slayer, all-living, the bull, bestower of vigor in our songs. Come to us with the bonds of friendship, the auspicious ones; great with great protections, as the swift one.

sanskrit: tam a̍ṅgira̱svan nama̍sā sapa̱ryan navya̍ṁ kṛṇomi̱ sanya̍se purā̱jām | druho̱ vi yā̍hi bahu̱lā ade̍vī̱ḥ sva̍ś ca no maghavan sā̱taye̍ dhāḥ ||
english: Honoring him with homage like an Aṅgiras, I make him new for the ancient gain. Go away from us the many godless treacheries; and heaven, O bountiful, establish for our winning.

sanskrit: miha̍ḥ pāva̱kāḥ prata̍tā abhūvan sva̱sti na̍ḥ pipṛhi pā̱ram ā̍sām | indra̱ tvaṁ ra̍thi̱raḥ pā̍hi no ri̱ṣo ma̱kṣū-ma̍kṣū kṛṇuhi go̱jito̍ naḥ ||
english: Purifying mists have spread out; bring us across them for well-being. O Indra, you the charioteer, protect us from injury; speedily, ever-speedily make us victorious in cattle.

sanskrit: ade̍diṣṭa vṛtra̱hā gopa̍ti̱r gā a̱ntaḥ kṛ̱ṣṇām̐ a̍ru̱ṣair dhāma̍bhir gāt | pra sū̱nṛtā̍ di̱śamā̍na ṛ̱tena̱ dura̍ś ca̱ viśvā̍ avṛṇo̱d apa̱ svāḥ ||
english: The Vṛtra-slayer, the lord of cattle, has pointed out the cows; he went among the dark ones with his reddish rays. Directing true words with truth, he opened wide all the doors from his home.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: For good fortune let us call the bountiful Indra, the most heroic in this battle for the prize; the fierce one who hears, for protection in the fights, who slays the Vṛtras, the conqueror of riches.

sanskrit: indra̱ soma̍ṁ somapate̱ pibe̱mam mādhya̍ṁdina̱ṁ sava̍na̱ṁ cāru̱ yat te̍ | pra̱pruthyā̱ śipre̍ maghavann ṛjīṣin vi̱mucyā̱ harī̍ i̱ha mā̍dayasva ||
english: O Indra, O Soma-lord, drink this Soma — the midday pressing, which is dear to you. Puffing out your jaws, O bountiful, O Ṛjīṣin, here unharness your bay horses and rejoice.

sanskrit: gavā̍śiram ma̱nthina̍m indra śu̱kram pibā̱ soma̍ṁ rari̱mā te̱ madā̍ya | bra̱hma̱kṛtā̱ māru̍tenā ga̱ṇena̍ sa̱joṣā̍ ru̱drais tṛ̱pad ā vṛ̍ṣasva ||
english: O Indra, drink this soma mixed with milk, this bright churned drink — we have yielded it to you for your intoxication. With the prayer-created Marut troop, delighting together with the Rudras, drink your fill three times, O bull.

sanskrit: ye te̱ śuṣma̱ṁ ye tavi̍ṣī̱m ava̍rdha̱nn arca̍nta indra ma̱ruta̍s ta̱ oja̍ḥ | mādhya̍ṁdine̱ sava̍ne vajrahasta̱ pibā̍ ru̱drebhi̱ḥ saga̍ṇaḥ suśipra ||
english: The Maruts who increased your vigor and your power, O Indra, sang your might. O wielder of the thunderbolt, at the midday pressing, O fair-jawed one, drink together with the Rudras in their troop.

sanskrit: ta in nv a̍sya̱ madhu̍mad vivipra̱ indra̍sya̱ śardho̍ ma̱ruto̱ ya āsa̍n | yebhi̍r vṛ̱trasye̍ṣi̱to vi̱vedā̍ma̱rmaṇo̱ manya̍mānasya̱ marma̍ ||
english: Indeed, those were the sweet, richly inspired troop of Indra, the Maruts who were there. By whom, as Vṛtra was set in motion, we found the vital spot of him who thought he had no vital spot.

sanskrit: ma̱nu̱ṣvad i̍ndra̱ sava̍naṁ juṣā̱ṇaḥ pibā̱ soma̱ṁ śaśva̍te vī̱ryā̍ya | sa ā va̍vṛtsva haryaśva ya̱jñaiḥ sa̍ra̱ṇyubhi̍r a̱po arṇā̍ sisarṣi ||
english: O Indra, accepting the pressing as Manu did, drink the Soma for perennial heroic power. O bay-horsed one, turn yourself toward us with sacrifices; you rush the waters like the swift streams.

sanskrit: tvam a̱po yad dha̍ vṛ̱traṁ ja̍gha̱nvām̐ atyā̍m̐ iva̱ prāsṛ̍ja̱ḥ sarta̱vājau̍ | śayā̍nam indra̱ cara̍tā va̱dhena̍ vavri̱vāṁsa̱m pari̍ de̱vīr ade̍vam ||
english: You, O Indra, when you had slain Vṛtra, released the waters like swift racers to run. With a roaming weapon, the divine ones encompassed the un-divine one who was lying, wrapped up.

sanskrit: yajā̍ma̱ in nama̍sā vṛ̱ddham indra̍m bṛ̱hanta̍m ṛ̱ṣvam a̱jara̱ṁ yuvā̍nam | yasya̍ pri̱ye ma̱matu̍r ya̱jñiya̍sya̱ na roda̍sī mahi̱māna̍m ma̱māte̍ ||
english: We worship with homage Indra the grown, the great, the lofty, the ageless, the ever-young. Of this adorable one whose dear ones have been intoxicated, heaven and earth have not encompassed his greatness.

sanskrit: indra̍sya̱ karma̱ sukṛ̍tā pu̱rūṇi̍ vra̱tāni̍ de̱vā na mi̍nanti̱ viśve̍ | dā̱dhāra̱ yaḥ pṛ̍thi̱vīṁ dyām u̱temāṁ ja̱jāna̱ sūrya̍m u̱ṣasa̍ṁ su̱daṁsā̍ḥ ||
english: The many well-performed deeds of Indra — all the gods do not diminish his ordinances. He who has sustained both earth and this heaven, the one of great wonders who begot the sun and the dawn.

sanskrit: adro̍gha sa̱tyaṁ tava̱ tan ma̍hi̱tvaṁ sa̱dyo yaj jā̱to api̍bo ha̱ soma̍m | na dyāva̍ indra ta̱vasa̍s ta̱ ojo̱ nāhā̱ na māsā̍ḥ śa̱rado̍ varanta ||
english: O guileless one, true is that greatness of yours — that immediately upon being born you drank the Soma. Heaven did not encompass, O Indra, the strength of your might, nor the days, nor the months, nor the years.

sanskrit: tvaṁ sa̱dyo a̍pibo jā̱ta i̍ndra̱ madā̍ya̱ soma̍m para̱me vyo̍man | yad dha̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī āvi̍veśī̱r athā̍bhavaḥ pū̱rvyaḥ kā̱rudhā̍yāḥ ||
english: Immediately upon being born, O Indra, you drank the Soma in the highest heaven for your intoxication. When you entered heaven and earth, then you became the primordial nourisher of the singers.

sanskrit: aha̱nn ahi̍m pari̱śayā̍na̱m arṇa̍ ojā̱yamā̍naṁ tuvijāta̱ tavyā̍n | na te̍ mahi̱tvam anu̍ bhū̱d adha̱ dyaur yad a̱nyayā̍ sphi̱gyā̱3̱̍ kṣām ava̍sthāḥ ||
english: You slew the serpent lying around the flood, the ever-strengthening, most powerful, O much-born. Even heaven then did not match your greatness when you stood upon the earth with your other hip.

sanskrit: ya̱jño hi ta̍ indra̱ vardha̍no̱ bhūd u̱ta pri̱yaḥ su̱taso̍mo mi̱yedha̍ḥ | ya̱jñena̍ ya̱jñam a̍va ya̱jñiya̱ḥ san ya̱jñas te̱ vajra̍m ahi̱hatya̍ āvat ||
english: For the sacrifice, O Indra, has been your increaser, and dear to you is the sacrifice where Soma is pressed. Being a sacrificial god, he protects sacrifice with sacrifice; the sacrifice supported your thunderbolt for the smiting of the serpent.

sanskrit: ya̱jñenendra̱m ava̱sā ca̍kre a̱rvāg aina̍ṁ su̱mnāya̱ navya̍se vavṛtyām | yaḥ stome̍bhir vāvṛ̱dhe pū̱rvyebhi̱r yo ma̍dhya̱mebhi̍r u̱ta nūta̍nebhiḥ ||
english: With the sacrifice I have drawn Indra near for protection; I would turn him toward us for newer grace. He who has grown with the ancient hymns, who has grown with the middle ones and also with the new ones.

sanskrit: vi̱veṣa̱ yan mā̍ dhi̱ṣaṇā̍ ja̱jāna̱ stavai̍ pu̱rā pāryā̱d indra̱m ahna̍ḥ | aṁha̍so̱ yatra̍ pī̱para̱d yathā̍ no nā̱veva̱ yānta̍m u̱bhaye̍ havante ||
english: What Dhiṣaṇā has generated has entered in — I would praise Indra before the end of the day. Where he would free us from distress — as both sides call upon the one going like a ship.

sanskrit: āpū̍rṇo asya ka̱laśa̱ḥ svāhā̱ sekte̍va̱ kośa̍ṁ sisice̱ piba̍dhyai | sam u̍ pri̱yā āva̍vṛtra̱n madā̍ya pradakṣi̱ṇid a̱bhi somā̍sa̱ indra̍m ||
english: His vessel is full; like a vessel for Svāhā it has poured into a container for drinking. And the dear ones have come around together for intoxication — the Soma streams clockwise toward Indra.

sanskrit: na tvā̍ gabhī̱raḥ pu̍ruhūta̱ sindhu̱r nādra̍ya̱ḥ pari̱ ṣanto̍ varanta | i̱tthā sakhi̍bhya iṣi̱to yad i̱ndrā dṛ̱ḻhaṁ ci̱d aru̍jo̱ gavya̍m ū̱rvam ||
english: No deep river, O much-invoked, no surrounding rocks have encompassed you. Thus, when impelled by friends, O Indra, you broke open even the firm, cattle-holding enclosure.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: For good fortune let us call the bountiful Indra, the most heroic in this battle for the prize; the fierce one who hears, for protection in the fights, who slays the Vṛtras, the conqueror of riches.
